summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built performance-critical C++ and CUDA C++ code with measured results (~35% faster GPU convolution kernels, up to 30x MPI speedup) and concurrent systems across CUDA, MPI and FreeRTOS. Shipped bare-metal embedded C firmware and a multi-device edge pipeline with 100% pick reliability over 10 trials.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to homography-based stitching baseline.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.
Achieved 1.5–2× speedup in convolution operations through efficient global memory utilization.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000×5000 pixel scenes using MPI.
Achieved up to 30× speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes); demonstrated dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
